# Cleaning & Preparation

Remove rust, scale, paint and weld discoloration before coating or bonding. Tell us your material, current process and target finish, and we will recommend the right product and grit sequence.

## Recommended products

- [Flap Discs](https://arsen-industrial.com/products/flap-discs.md): Flap discs for angle grinders that grind and finish in one step on welds, edges and flat surfaces.
